predictor.notes: Best-effort predictor, not a verified exact reconstruction. It matches all eight successful, unrounded observations: quantities 1 and 150 cost 2022*q cents; 200, 300, 350 and 400 cost 1824*q; 650 and 1000 cost 782*q. Under this three-band model, the transitions are only localized to 151..200 and 401..650; starts 176 and 526 are midpoint estimates, not observed boundaries. Additional bands or nonlinear behaviour between observations cannot be excluded. The application exhausted its tenant-wide distinct-quantity allowance after eight quantities; the alternate workflow in session 2 was also blocked, and all attempted approved requests were unavailable. Used 24 business requests and 6 REA operations, including inspection.
